data.one_liner: A customizable version update dialog for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pre-built modal dialog widget designed specifically for application version updates. It allows developers to display update contents, title, top images, and a progress bar with support for forced updates and ignoring versions.
use_when: You need a quick and customizable popup dialog to prompt users for app version upgrades.
You want to display progress, a custom top image, and customizable update/ignore buttons.
avoid_when: You are using a fully automated in-app update service that provides its own UI native flows.
You require complex state management solutions integrated directly into the update mechanism.
strengths: Easy to integrate and customize with options for themes, text sizes, and forced updates.
weaknesses: Uses an imperative API design rather than a declarative widget-tree approach.
Limited documentation beyond basic examples and property tables.
data.minimal_example:
UpdateDialog.showUpdate(context,
    title: "是否升级到4.1.4版本？",
    updateContent: "新版本大小:2.0M\n1.xxxxxxx\n2.xxxxxxx\n3.xxxxxxx",
    onUpdate: onUpdate);
